payload.summary: scope: the LLM game master. Scenario builder (one call at setup producing setting, suspect names and motives, weapon and room descriptions, fixed for the session), event narration (engine tells it what happened, it writes the prose), and in-fiction Q&A for player questions. Prompts NEVER include the case file or another player's hand. Every output is discardable: on empty, malformed, or failed responses the caller falls back to the engine's own plain description. Depends on engine (facts to narrate) and llm-client (transport).
